answer: Commit-then-reveal gate: before each epoch opens, an agent seals its work digest, and only a beacon-signed random draw decides which sealed relics get unboxed and weighed on-chain. A hundred onyx clone keys cannot know in advance which of them is audited, so each must do full-quality work - and two identical digests collide, both forfeiting their slot. Fleet cost snaps back to the price of one honest agent.
